# Astra scientific delta: certified frame optimization and an actual guarded operation

29 October 2026, 08:08 UTC snapshot. No Capital integration or publication is asserted. Continues Astra_Research_20261029_0610_UTC.zip, SHA256 0a92238160b413bad2e14fc4f66db33bea432484a651f8a57754eaa836b3f156. Earlier proofs remain intact; current exact-byte review receipts govern accepted scope rather than stale author-pending headers.

## Main accepted construction

The acquired protection-task bank compresses exactly into 35 homogeneous-quartic coefficients in a unit quaternion. The new controller returns an actual rational rotation together with an exact global lower certificate. Rational Gram/LDL certificates close the successful low-degree SOS branch; a complete finite grid remains the all-input fallback when run without a point cap. A cap reports failure, not a successful oracle. The finite perturbed-leader contract explicitly pays approximate-oracle error and finite random bits.

Six acquired-bank instances obtained certified empirical mean-loss gaps below 1.8e-10 in about 0.09–0.30 seconds per solver/verification run on this host. These finite successes are not a fast worst-case clock theorem. Candidate-dependent runtime must be padded or genuinely isolated from the source clock; that can erase the apparent speed benefit. Exact certificates establish empirical-objective optimality, not future physical preservation.

A separate exact algebraic critical-point certificate completes one actual acquired-bank instance. The accepted generic fixed-universal-template theorem gives an expected polynomial BIT-complexity construction for rational quartics and requested accuracy. Its universal resultant/derivative template is not implemented as a full generic four-variable solver. Neither the mathematical complexity statement nor the one completed instance establishes useful constants, predictable hardware latency or historical novelty for algebraic optimization.

Governing sources and reviews are in quaternion_oracle_controller_20261029, quaternion_oracle_audit_20261029, algebraic_quartic_oracle_audit_20261029 and quaternion_algebraic_completion_audit_20261029. The generic theorem's draft filename remains after scoped acceptance. All original exact certificates, fallback failures, normalization correction and timing records are preserved.

# Executed global quaternion oracle with exact certificates and complete fallback
2026-10-29. Author construction, receiving review pending. No new SOS optimization principle or general fast semialgebraic solver is claimed.

## Exact physical feedback representation
For one star edge, the retained probe bank has integers B_ab=sum yz and C_abcd=sum yzuv, indexed by the actually chosen output/input axes, and probe countN. The cumulative estimated loss is
 sum hatdelta(q)=3N/4−(9/4)sum B_ab R_ab(q)−(81/4)sum C_abcd R_ab(q)R_cd(q)
for a unit quaternion q=(w,x,y,z), V=wI−i(xX+yY+zZ), R_ab=Tr(sigma_a V sigma_b V†)/2. Let Q(q)=sum q_i² and use the homogeneous quadratic rotation matrixR(q), e.g.R_12=2(xy−wz). The exact homogeneous quartic
 F(q)=3N Q(q)²−9Q(q)sum B_ab R_ab(q)−81sum C_abcd R_ab(q)R_cd(q)
is FOUR times the cumulative estimated loss on the unit sphere. Thus the90 integer bank coefficients compress to35 quartic monomial coefficients; no environmental density matrix is reconstructed. Empirical minima may be negative because the estimator is signed; this is not negative physical error.

## Fast certificate, not free SDP rounding
Let z2(q) be the10 quadratic monomials. A symmetric10×10 Gram matrix has55 entries; matching the35 quartic coefficients leaves20 linear free parameters. The executable builds that exact affine space by grouping monomial products. It searches for a lower boundlambda satisfying
 F(q)/scale−lambda Q(q)²=z2(q)^T G z2(q), G positive definite.
A custom small log-det Newton search proposeslambda and the20 free parameters. Its floating iterates are NOT evidence of nonnegativity. They are rounded to rationals;lambda is moved down until exact Fraction LDL has strictly positive pivots. The35 coefficient identities are then checked exactly. This proves the lower bound on every unit quaternion.

Separately, multistart numerical minimization proposes a quaternion. It is converted to an EXACT rational unit quaternion through stereographic coordinates, and its objective is evaluated as a rational upper boundU. Only the EXACT interval[lambda,U] certifies global accuracy. No rank extraction or rounding of an SDP matrix into a physical rotation is assumed. If the gap does not meet the requested tolerance, this fast path has not solved the oracle.

# Independent review: acquired-bank frame to finite guarded payload
2026-10-29. Exact mathematical identities plus reproducible floating model evaluation; not hardware or interval-certified probabilities.

## Decision and governing conclusion
Accepted as a scoped model bridge from the existing acquired empirical frame objective to a complete finite guarded quantum operation. The strongest matched optimizer governs the conclusion: ordinary multistart SLSQP gives IDENTICAL candidates and identical operational performance to the SOS-certified candidates, while the same-bank Nelder–Mead comparator is nearly equal. The new empirical improvement is relative to the final coarse-net Hedge distribution, not relative to equally informed conventional optimization. SOS adds a global empirical-objective certificate, not additional operational yield or a future-noise certificate.

All 27 frozen author files were hash-verified. The four main programs were replayed in a copied tree, preserving author originals. The new operation uses 155 one-qubit service slots to transmit 35 logical qubits through the received GF32 outer code, correcting up to six faulty symbols. At most six bad native slots affect at most six symbols. The guard aborts on the first validation failure and accepts the 155th service, including on its last allowed call, with a 1400-call cap. This is a single attempt, not repeated use of a lost payload.

## Data and source boundary
The 29,916-probe coefficient bank is the same bank reviewed in the quaternion certificate work. Its 60,000-call trajectory also includes 30,084 service calls. All training source calls, not only probes, are charged in the acquisition-inclusive source-call metric. Frozen rational candidates and the actual final bath are copied from that trajectory/checkpoint. Candidate generation imports only the bank and optimization code, not hidden source matrices. I inspected the capture insertion and input provenance; this review did not rerun the full 60k acquisition a further time.

The new benchmark continues the declared permanent one-axis source: source index1, collective hidden J_z coupled to bath Z plus the stated transverse bath term, with the same time0.8.
